name: Yo!Yumm GloriaFood marketplace clone + AiBotick WA F&B
summary: Two peers (Composio FETCH 2026-09-04): (1) **Yo!Yumm** — self-hosted white-label **multi-restaurant marketplace** (Uber Eats–class ownership) pitched as GloriaFood Apr 30 2027 successor; one-time license / source ownership — different class from single-restaurant OO (iShopo/Menuro); watch as migration FOMO peer, not FBE. (2) **AiBotick** — WhatsApp Business API for restaurants/cloud kitchens: in-chat menu+cart, Razorpay/UPI, delivery tracking, POS webhooks, table reservations. Watch with Menuthere/Waplify; not Meta FBE; fee pause.
what_it_does: GloriaFood-era operators either become marketplace operators (Yo!Yumm) or shift order capture to WhatsApp automation (AiBotick).
how_competitors_use_it: Migrate GloriaFood menus into owned marketplace stack; or run WA catalog OO with payment in-chat.
what_we_use_today: GloriaFood EOL Shop wedge; Hyperzod/Saaztro/iShopo successors; WA peer set
gap: Yo!Yumm recreates aggregator economics under own brand — sharpens why Shop/direct rails beat rebuilding marketplace rent
not_this: Not Meta FBE. Not fee dogfood. Not forecasting. Yo!Yumm ≠ single-restaurant commission-free OO.
